result:
I shipped v29.51 (cw-craftbar). It covers the two craft items on his list: the hold bar and crafting several at once. Preflight and the ship gate both passed, and the seed 4242 fingerprint was unchanged. I took no before or after screenshots and didn't run the critic, so how the bench looks hasn't been judged by anyone.

- **Hold bar:** the old fill was faint amber over an amber button, so a hold looked like nothing was happening. Pressing now turns the button into a dark track with a solid amber fill and light text. It goes back to normal when the hold ends or fires.
- **Craft several at once:** chips x1, x5, x10 and Max appear above the hold button when the stash holds at least two sets. One 1-second hold crafts that many, never more than the stash allows, and a toast says "Crafted xN". The button label shows the count, for example "HOLD TO CRAFT x3".

The rocket launcher was already shipped by lane b (v29.15 keys, v29.18 gun), and the frame cap options were already in. One line on his evening list is still unconfirmed: consolidating the Scav pistol and SMG slots. Lane b's marksman removal doesn't clearly cover it, so it needs a decision on whether it's still wanted. "What else for the tuning console" is also still open.

I marked the craft item DONE in `notes/evening.md` and added the line to `notes/ui/changes.md`.

TASK DONE
